

| Dr. Alando Walter is an urban development planning practitioner and researcher. His professional practice focuses on urban development research, urban governance, urban development planning, climate change resilience planning, and GIS.  He has consulted for International Governmental Organisations, the national government of Kenya, municipalities in Kenya and the East African region, various county governments, private-sector organisations, and Non-Governmental Organisations. Dr. Alando is a corporate member of the Kenya Institute of Planners, a lead member of the Environment Institute of Kenya. | ![C:\\Users\\oxygen\\Downloads\\IMG-20200716-WA0008.jpg][image1] |
